description: Check detected source-language profiles, project roots, executables, compile flags and freshness. Call once before orient in a new project or when orientation is incomplete. Pass profile/project to inspect a nested package.

profile.description: Source-language profile; required for bare names in mixed workspaces.

project.description: Workspace-relative project directory, e.g. tools/driver for a nested Cargo package. Without it, a path:line:column symbol is answered from its enclosing Cargo workspace, else from its nearest project marker (a warning says when that leaves part of the workspace out).

name: status
title: Project, language server and index status
